items.title: Chronicles of the Red Sun, Vol. 1
items.subtitle: Illustrated & Annotated Edo Kaidan
items.shortDescription: Eleven complete, unabridged tales of Edo- and Meiji-period supernatural folklore, newly translated with 22 dark painterly illustrations, historical provenance essays, scholarly footnotes, and an optional 4-hour unabridged audiobook edition.
fullDescription: Step into the shadowed archives of feudal Japan. Chronicles of the Red Sun, Vol. 1 gathers eleven complete, unabridged tales of Edo- and Meiji-period supernatural folklore (Kaidan), newly translated, illustrated, and annotated for modern readers.

Available as a Kindle eBook and 6x9 inch Paperback on Amazon, or directly from our official Ko-fi archive as a DRM-free Collector's Ivory PDF, an unabridged 4-hour 11-chapter MP3 Audiobook, or a combined Bundle.
